name: 1X EVE
summary: 1X EVE is a wheeled humanoid robot from 1X Technologies aimed at mobile service work in institutional and industrial settings.
description: EVE is a wheeled humanoid robot by 1X Technologies designed for industrial and institutional environments. Standing 188 cm (6’2″) tall and weighing 87 kg, EVE can travel at speeds up to 4 m/s (9 mph), carry 15 kg payloads, and operate for 6 hours on a single charge. Its multi-terrain wheels enable navigation around corners and elevator access. EVE features embodied AI learning technology combining advanced robotics with artificial intelligence for logistics, security, healthcare, and facility management applications. Backed by OpenAI Startup Fund.

name: 1X NEO
summary: 1X NEO is a bipedal humanoid robot from 1X Technologies aimed at home and light commercial assistance. It is ~1.68m tall, ~30kg, and uses onboard AI compute for autonomy and interaction.
description: NEO is a human-form, bipedal robot designed for safe operation in indoor environments such as homes and hospitality spaces. It stands ~1.68m tall and weighs ~30kg, with 39 DoF and 22-DoF hands. Listed specs include up to 1.4 m/s walking speed, ~240 min runtime (842 Wh), stereo fisheye cameras, IMU, Wi‑Fi/Bluetooth/5G connectivity, and IP68 hands with IP44 body.

name: NEO Gamma
summary: NEO Gamma is 1X Technologies’ next-generation home humanoid robot in the NEO Gamma Series.
description: NEO Gamma is a bipedal humanoid robot platform from 1X Technologies aimed at operation in home environments. It is described by 1X as the next generation of NEO home humanoids, with improvements across hardware and AI and a design intended to fit life at home. It is relevant for consumer home use and ongoing research and development.

name: IRB 1300
summary: ABB IRB 1300 is a compact 6-axis industrial robot arm for high-speed production automation tasks.
description: ABB IRB 1300 is a fixed, 6-axis industrial articulated robot designed for space-efficient automation. It targets applications such as machine tending, material handling, and related manufacturing processes. The series is offered with payload options up to 11 kg and is typically integrated with ABB RobotStudio programming and ABB controllers as part of a complete robot cell.

name: ANYmal X
summary: ANYmal X is an ATEX/IECEx-certified quadruped inspection robot from ANYbotics for operation in explosive industrial zones.
description: ANYmal X by ANYbotics is a quadruped robot built for autonomous inspection missions in industrial sites such as power & utilities, mining, oil & gas, chemicals, and rail. It patrols environments to collect operational data and provide actionable insights for maintenance and safety programs. The platform is aimed at enterprise deployments and research use.

name: AUBO i10
summary: AUBO i10 is a 6-axis collaborative industrial robot arm with a 10 kg payload for factory automation.
description: AUBO i10 is a stationary 6-DOF collaborative robot arm (cobot) from AUBO Robotics with a 10 kg payload. It is intended for industrial automation tasks such as assembly, pick-and-place, and machine tending, with built-in safety functions like collision detection and emergency stop and integration options such as Ethernet and ROS 1 support.

name: AgiBot G2
summary: AgiBot G2 is an industrial humanoid robot platform built for versatile factory and logistics tasks, with onboard AI for long-sequence task execution.
description: The AgiBot G2 is a next-generation industrial humanoid robot designed to handle complex applications in manufacturing, logistics, and public-facing roles. It incorporates AI-driven versatility, extending beyond traditional automation tasks.

name: AgiBot X1
summary: AgiBot X1 is a 130 cm, 33 kg open-source humanoid platform with 34 DOF for research and education.
description: The AgiBot X1 is a 130 cm open-source humanoid robot platform designed for researchers and makers. It combines affordability and advanced features, making bipedal robotics accessible for innovation and development.

name: Digit
summary: Digit is Agility Robotics' commercially deployed bipedal humanoid for industrial material-handling workflows in facilities designed around people.
description: Digit is Agility Robotics' commercially deployed bipedal humanoid robot for warehouses, manufacturing, logistics, and distribution environments. Agility positions Digit as a human-centric automation tool that can work in existing facilities, bridge islands of automation, carry totes or materials, use interchangeable end effectors, and connect with Arc for fleet and workflow management.

name: Apollo
summary: Apollo is a bipedal humanoid robot from Apptronik aimed at automating tasks in industrial and commercial environments.
description: Apollo is a versatile humanoid robot from Apptronik built for tasks in commercial, industrial, and supply chain environments. It is engineered for safety, adaptability, and intuitive interaction with humans.

name: Tiangong Series
summary: Tiangong Series is a government-backed, open-source electric humanoid robot family from Beijing HRIC with Lite, Pro, and Max variants.
description: Beijing HRIC’s Tiangong Series is a bipedal, electric humanoid robot platform described as open-source and offered in three variants (Lite, Pro, Max). It is positioned as a general-purpose system for R&D, education, and commercial experimentation, supporting semi-autonomous operation with SLAM, path planning, computer vision, voice interaction, and ROS support.

name: TP-01 EDU
summary: TP-01 EDU is the EDU and secondary-development configuration of the TP-01 humanoid robot from Chengdu Humanoid Robot Innovation Center, with a 19-inch screen, manual controller support, voice interaction, accessory expansion, and quick-swap battery support listed in the manufacturer-provided catalog.
description: The manufacturer-provided TP-01 catalog lists TP-01 EDU as an 850 mm, 34 kg bipedal humanoid robot with head and body degrees of freedom, 3-hour battery life, 0.6 m/s forward speed, a 19-inch screen, 4G/Bluetooth/WiFi communication, quick-swap battery support, manual controller support, speaker, microphone array, voice interaction, accessory expansion, and secondary development support. In the same comparison table, app and management platform, group control, and intelligent following and formation parade are listed for TP-01 Standard but shown as not listed for TP-01 EDU.

name: Husky UGV
summary: Clearpath Husky UGV is a rugged, four-wheel unmanned ground vehicle (UGV) platform for outdoor robotics R&D and prototyping.
description: Husky UGV is a skid-steer, wheeled outdoor mobile base used for autonomy and field robotics research. It supports ROS-based development on Ubuntu, integrates common sensors (e.g., LiDAR, IMU), and is built to carry research payloads such as compute, sensors, and small manipulators. Typical use cases include autonomous navigation, mapping/SLAM, and perception experiments in real environments.

name: Racer-5-0.80
summary: Comau Racer-5-0.80 is a compact 6-axis industrial robot arm designed for high-speed handling tasks with a 5 kg payload.
description: Racer-5-0.80 is a stationary 6-axis industrial articulated robot arm from Comau with 5 kg max payload and ~809 mm reach. It is intended for high-speed pick-and-place, assembly, and machine tending in manufacturing cells, with multiple mounting orientations (floor/ceiling/wall) and IP54 protection.

name: COBOTTA PRO 900
summary: COBOTTA PRO 900 is a 6‑axis collaborative robot arm in DENSO Robotics’ COBOTTA PRO series for high-speed, human-collaborative industrial automation.
description: DENSO Robotics COBOTTA PRO 900 is a stationary 6‑axis collaborative robot arm intended for manufacturing automation tasks such as assembly, machine tending, and inspection. It is designed for productivity-focused cobot deployments and integrates with DENSO’s controller/software ecosystem; availability and pricing are typically provided on request.

name: Atom
summary: Dobot Atom is a 1.53 m, 62 kg humanoid prototype by Dobot Robotics with 41 DOF and an AI system aimed at industrial and service tasks.
description: The Dobot Atom is a next-generation humanoid robot developed by Shenzhen-based Dobot Robotics. Designed for both industrial and service applications, Atom combines advanced AI, precision mechanics, and energy-efficient mobility in a compact form.

name: Atom Max
summary: DOBOT ATOM is Dobot Robotics’ first full-size humanoid robot aimed at embodied AI research and cross-scenario industrial/commercial task automation.
description: DOBOT ATOM is a full-size biped humanoid robot with a Neuro‑Driven Dexterity System (NDS) and Anthropomorphic Walking System (AWS). Dobot states it provides 28 upper-body DoF, 200 Hz high-frequency control, and binocular RGB vision for dexterous manipulation plus straight-knee walking for efficient mobility. Target tasks include automotive assembly handling, beverage preparation, and pharmacy dispensing.

name: M0609 Cobot
summary: Doosan Robotics M0609 is a 6‑axis collaborative robot arm (cobot) with a 6 kg payload and ~900 mm reach for industrial automation.
description: M0609 is a stationary 6‑DOF collaborative robot arm from Doosan Robotics (M‑Series) rated for a 6 kg payload and about 900 mm reach. It targets tasks such as assembly, machine tending, surface finishing, and material handling where close human-robot collaboration and direct teaching are needed. Sold through Doosan’s dealer network with support/training via Dart‑Suite and services.

name: Mercury X1
summary: Mercury X1 is Elephant Robotics’ wheeled humanoid research platform with a 7‑axis arm and onboard NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano compute.
description: Mercury X1 is a universal wheeled humanoid robot from Elephant Robotics combining a mobile base with a 7‑axis robotic arm. It’s intended for education and research and supports secondary development via Python and C++ APIs plus common robotics tools (ROS, MoveIt, Gazebo, MuJoCo). The mobile base integrates lidar, ultrasonic sensing, and visual guidance; listed endurance is up to 8 hours.

name: myBuddy
summary: myBuddy is Elephant Robotics’ dual-arm, semi-humanoid desktop robot launched in 2022 for research and education.
description: myBuddy is a compact, semi-humanoid dual-arm robot from Elephant Robotics (launched 2022) aimed at research and education. It provides two 6-DOF arms (13 DOF total) for bimanual manipulation and coordination experiments, with onboard compute commonly configured with Ubuntu + ROS and a depth camera for vision-based tasks.

name: PM01 Humanoid Robot
summary: EngineAI PM01 is a full-size bipedal humanoid robot platform intended for education and research use.
description: The EngineAI PM01 is a bipedal humanoid robot platform aimed at education and research, with onboard compute and ROS 2 support for developing perception and locomotion software. Listed capabilities include multi-camera vision (including depth and stereo), LiDAR, voice interaction, and autonomous navigation functions. It is specified at 1.7 m tall, 85 kg, ~32 DOF, 10 kg payload, and up to ~3 m/s running speed.

name: SA02 Humanoid Robot
summary: EngineAI SA02 is a compact humanoid social robot teased for young people, with AI-driven interaction and bipedal mobility.
description: The SA02 Humanoid Robot is designed to showcase advanced human-like mobility and interaction capabilities, aimed at research and commercial applications. It features cutting-edge AI and dynamic motion control.

name: SE01 Humanoid Robot
summary: EngineAI SE01 is a full-size bipedal humanoid focused on smooth, human-like gait for research and industrial applications.
description: The SE01 humanoid robot is aimed at providing realistic human-like movements and is intended for education and research purposes. It is part of EngineAI's effort to make robotics technology serve humanity.

name: T800 Humanoid Robot
summary: EngineAI T800 is a full-size humanoid (bipedal) robot shown in 2025 as a heavy-duty platform and planned “Robot Boxer” competitor.
description: EngineAI’s T800 is a full-size bipedal humanoid introduced publicly around the 2025 World Robot Conference. Reporting describes it as a heavy-duty platform for high-stress R&D demos (e.g., robot boxing) with 41 DOF joints, ~1.85 m height, ~85 kg mass, a solid‑state battery, and aluminum-alloy exterior covers, with longer-term aims toward industrial and service deployment.

name: Ami Desktop
summary: Ami Desktop is a stationary, desktop-sized expressive robot head from Engineered Arts for HRI and conversational AI research and education.
description: Ami Desktop is a compact, stationary humanoid-style robot head for lab and classroom use. It provides expressive facial motion (10 DoF) plus camera-based perception and voice interaction for human-robot interaction demos and research. It supports Linux-based computing with ROS 2 support and wired/wireless connectivity for integration into AI and robotics projects.

name: Mesmer
summary: Mesmer is a hyper-realistic humanoid robot from Engineered Arts focused on lifelike facial expression and human-robot interaction.
description: Mesmer by Engineered Arts is a human-form social robot built for exhibitions, entertainment, and research into embodied interaction. It emphasizes expressive facial animation, eye contact, and naturalistic conversation-driven demos. Publicly listed specs include ~1.75 m height, 62 kg weight, multi-camera vision, microphone array, and Ethernet/Wi‑Fi connectivity; sales are via custom order/contact.

name: LS20-B
summary: Epson Robots LS20-B is a 4-axis SCARA industrial robot designed for high-speed factory automation tasks up to 20 kg payload.
description: LS20-B is an Epson 4-axis SCARA industrial robot arm for high-speed, high-throughput automation. It is used for assembly, pick-and-place, machine tending and related handling operations in manufacturing environments. The LS20-B is rated for a 20 kg maximum payload and is typically programmed using Epson RC+ software.

name: ER20
summary: Estun ER20 is a 6-axis industrial articulated robot arm with a rated 20 kg payload for factory automation tasks.
description: ER20 is a stationary 6‑DOF industrial articulated robot arm from Estun Automation with a 20 kg payload rating. It is intended for manufacturing automation such as material handling, machine tending, and similar general-purpose industrial workflows. Integration is typically via industrial controllers and Ethernet; detailed reach/speed options vary by configuration.

name: CRX-10iA
summary: FANUC CRX-10iA is a 6-axis collaborative industrial robot arm with a 10 kg payload for factory automation tasks.
description: CRX-10iA is a 6-axis collaborative robot (cobot) arm designed for safe human-robot collaboration in industrial environments. It supports a 10 kg payload and is suited to machine tending, assembly, and material handling. FANUC emphasizes global service support through its network of locations across more than 100 countries.

name: Sprout Creator Edition
summary: Sprout Creator Edition is Fauna Robotics' lightweight humanoid developer platform for researchers, educators, creators, and commercial teams.
description: Fauna Robotics' Sprout Creator Edition is a 107 cm, 22.7 kg humanoid developer platform built for shared human spaces. It includes expressive interaction hardware, integrated grippers, onboard sensing, swappable batteries, Ethernet, and NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin 64GB compute so teams can prototype robotics applications in research, education, retail, entertainment, and home-service settings.

name: Figure 01
summary: Figure 01 is Figure AI’s first humanoid robot prototype for general-purpose labor in indoor commercial and industrial spaces.
description: Figure 01 is the first humanoid robot by Figure AI, designed as a general-purpose robotic worker capable of performing a wide range of tasks. It features human-like dexterity and is capable of working safely alongside people.

name: Figure 02
summary: Figure 02 is Figure AI’s second-generation humanoid robot for industrial work, introduced in 2024 and piloted in automotive manufacturing.
description: Figure 02 is a bipedal humanoid robot introduced in August 2024 for industrial deployments. It has 35 total degrees of freedom, five-finger hands with 16 DOF, and a rated carry capacity up to 25 kg. It includes integrated limb cabling, a torso-mounted battery, six RGB cameras, microphones and speakers, and onboard vision-language-action AI with increased compute (dual GPUs).

name: GR-2 Humanoid
summary: Fourier Intelligence GR-2 is a bipedal humanoid robot platform in the GRx series intended for embodied AI research and application development.
description: GR-2 is a full-size bipedal humanoid robot from Fourier Intelligence’s GRx series. It is positioned as a general-purpose robot assistant platform for research and enterprise exploration of embodied AI, with a Linux-based compute stack and ROS 2 support for integration and development.

name: FR3 Cobot
summary: Franka Research 3 (FR3) is a 7‑DoF, force-sensitive collaborative robot arm for robotics and AI research.
description: Franka Research 3 (FR3) is a stationary 7‑axis collaborative robot arm designed as a force-sensitive reference platform for robotics and AI. It targets research, education, and lab/industry prototyping, offering both easy-to-use features and low-level access to control and learning capabilities within the Franka ecosystem.

name: Palro
summary: Palro is a small humanoid communication robot by Fujisoft designed for interactive conversation and companionship.
description: Palro is a humanoid robot designed for educational and entertainment purposes, featuring AI-driven interactions, speech recognition, and motion capabilities. It serves as a learning companion and social robot.

name: Albert Hubo
summary: Albert HUBO is a KAIST HUBO-platform humanoid with an expressive Einstein-like animatronic head for HRI demos and research.
description: Albert Hubo is a humanoid robot that combines the bipedal mobility of the Hubo platform with an expressive, animatronic head modeled after Albert Einstein. It is designed for research, education, and entertainment purposes.

name: DRC-Hubo
summary: DRC-HUBO is a transformable humanoid disaster-response robot that won the DARPA Robotics Challenge Finals 2015.
description: DRC-Hubo is a humanoid robot designed for disaster response and rescue missions. It was developed to compete in the DARPA Robotics Challenge, showcasing advanced mobility and manipulation capabilities.

name: Hubo (KHR-2 based platform)
summary: HUBO (KHR-2 based) is a full-size biped humanoid research platform developed at KAIST. It is reported at 41 DOF, ~125 cm tall, and ~55 kg.
description: HUBO (KHR-2 based platform) is a biped humanoid robot developed at KAIST for research and education on humanoid mechanical design, balance, and locomotion. Literature reports 41 degrees of freedom with an overall height of about 125 cm and mass around 55 kg. It is a research platform rather than a general commercial product.

name: Hubo 2
summary: HUBO 2 is a KAIST Hubo Lab humanoid research robot focused on bipedal locomotion for walking and stair traversal studies.
description: Hubo 2 is a humanoid robot developed at the Hubo Lab of KAIST, focused on bipedal locomotion such as walking, running, and traversing stairs, enabling advanced testing of human-robot interaction and artificial intelligence.

name: Hubo FX-1
summary: HUBO FX-1 is an early HUBO humanoid robot platform from KAIST used for biped locomotion and human-carrying mobility research.
description: HUBO FX-1 is a research humanoid robot platform (KAIST HUBO Lab) focused on bipedal locomotion and mobility experiments, including carrying a person or payloads. It is a large, heavy biped with a relatively low degree-of-freedom configuration intended for lab development and demonstrations rather than general commercial deployment.

name: Hubo KHR-3
summary: HUBO KHR-3 is a prototype humanoid robot developed by KAIST’s HUBO Lab for robotics research. It is known for finger independence demonstrations such as rock‑paper‑scissors.
description: KHR-3 is a bipedal humanoid research platform from KAIST’s HUBO Lab (South Korea). It is a prototype intended for R&D and education, with articulated hands enabling independent finger motion (demonstrated via rock‑paper‑scissors). Commonly cited platform stats include 41 DOF and a roughly 125 cm, 55 kg body size, supporting full-body humanoid experiments.

name: M-Hubo
summary: M-Hubo is a wheeled humanoid research robot from KAIST’s HUBO Lab developed as an autonomous “robotic butler” platform for indoor fetch-and-serve tasks.
description: M-Hubo is a humanoid robot designed by KAIST for advanced research in robotics and mobility. It features dynamic walking capabilities and high degrees of freedom for versatile movement and manipulation.

name: Sophia
summary: Sophia is a Hanson Robotics social humanoid designed for human-robot interaction with expressive facial animations and conversational AI.
description: Sophia is a human-form social robot platform used for public engagement, education, and HRI research. It focuses on face-to-face interaction with speech recognition, speech output, and expressive facial mechanisms, and includes onboard cameras for perception (e.g., face detection/recognition). The Sophia 2020 configuration is listed at ~167 cm tall with 74 degrees of freedom.

name: AiNex ROS Education AI Vision Humanoid Robot
summary: AiNex is a compact ROS-enabled educational humanoid robot from Hiwonder with an HD camera for AI vision experiments.
description: The AiNex ROS Education AI Vision Humanoid Robot is designed to facilitate learning and research in robotics and artificial intelligence. It integrates advanced vision capabilities and ROS support, making it suitable for educational environments.

name: HiWonder TonyBot Humanoid Robot Kit
summary: Hiwonder TonyBot is a small humanoid (biped) robot kit for STEM learning with 16 DOF servo joints and app/program control.
description: The HiWonder TonyBot is a versatile humanoid robot kit designed for educational purposes and robotics enthusiasts. It enables users to explore robotics programming and artificial intelligence through hands-on experience.

name: ASIMO
summary: ASIMO is Honda’s humanoid biped robot developed for robotics R&D and public demonstrations, with autonomous walking/running and voice/face interaction.
description: ASIMO is an advanced humanoid robot developed by Honda with the ability to perform a wide range of interactive tasks, including walking, running, and recognizing faces and voices. It has been widely used in research and presentation environments.

name: Asimo
summary: ASIMO is Honda’s bipedal humanoid research robot developed to demonstrate advanced walking/running, balance, and human interaction.
description: Honda ASIMO is a 1.3 m tall, ~48 kg bipedal humanoid robot created as a robotics R&D and demonstration platform. It is known for stable dynamic locomotion (walking/running), stair climbing, and basic interaction tasks such as guiding or carrying small items. ASIMO was not sold as a commercial product and has been retired from active development.

name: HMND 01 Alpha
summary: HMND 01 Alpha is a humanoid-style robot on a wheeled base referenced in a 2025–2026 third-party comparison of humanoid robots. Public, verifiable specs and commercial details are not disclosed in that source.
description: HMND 01 Alpha (Humanoid, UK) is described in third-party reporting as an “industrial humanoid on wheels,” aimed at factory/warehouse-style environments rather than home use. Public, verifiable specifications and commercial details are limited; the referenced source focuses on claims vs. proven capabilities across the humanoid sector.

name: LBR iiwa 14 R820
summary: KUKA LBR iiwa 14 R820 is a 7-axis collaborative industrial robot arm with a 14 kg payload and ~820 mm reach.
description: LBR iiwa 14 R820 is a lightweight 7‑DOF collaborative robot arm for sensitive, force-controlled manipulation. The 14 kg payload and ~820 mm reach suit assembly, testing, machine tending, and lab automation where human-robot collaboration is required. It is designed for integration into industrial and research cells using KUKA control and software ecosystems.

name: NEXTAGE Fillie
summary: NEXTAGE Fillie is a stationary, dual‑arm humanoid upper‑body robot by Kawada Robotics for automation and R&D tasks.
description: Kawada Robotics’ NEXTAGE Fillie is a compact, stationary dual‑arm humanoid (upper body) used for industrial automation and research. It provides 15 DoF total (6 per arm), Ethernet connectivity, and ROS 1 support on an Intel Atom controller. Typical applications include cell-based assembly, parts handling, and lab/academic robotics development.

name: duAro
summary: Kawasaki duAro is a dual-arm SCARA industrial robot for table-top assembly and handling tasks.
description: duAro (dual-arm SCARA) is an industrial robot intended for cell-based automation where two coordinated arms handle parts, tools, and fixtures in a compact footprint. It is used for small-part assembly, machine tending, inspection/test handling, and packaging tasks typical in manufacturing environments.

name: DINERBOT T10
summary: Keenon DINERBOT T10 is a wheeled indoor service robot designed to deliver items such as meals in commercial venues.
description: DINERBOT T10 (Keenon Robotics) is an autonomous wheeled delivery robot for indoor commercial environments such as restaurants and hospitality venues. It uses onboard perception (camera + LiDAR) for navigation and obstacle avoidance and supports voice interaction. Listed specs include ~1.15 m height, ~35 kg weight, up to ~40 kg payload, ~1.2 m/s speed, and ~8 h runtime with ~4 h charge time.

name: Kinova Gen3
summary: Kinova Gen3 is a lightweight 7-DOF collaborative robotic arm for research and applied manipulation tasks.
description: Kinova Gen3 is a 7‑degree‑of‑freedom robotic arm designed for lab and real-world manipulation in research, education, and healthcare/service robotics. It is typically integrated on a stationary base or mobile platform and supports ROS-based development. It is positioned as a human-centric/collaborative arm for safe interaction and application prototyping.

name: KUAVO Humanoid
summary: KUAVO is Leju Robotics’ bipedal humanoid robot platform aimed at research and applied service/industrial scenarios.
description: KUAVO is a general-purpose bipedal humanoid robot from Leju Robotics’ KUAVO series, offered as an open research platform (e.g., KUAVO 4Pro, KUAVO 5/5‑W). It targets education and robotics research and is also positioned for business service and industrial scenario solutions (guidance/assistance roles, automotive/3C electronics, logistics). Availability and detailed specs vary by configuration and are typically provided on request.

name: CL-1 Humanoid Robot
summary: CL-1 is a bipedal humanoid robot platform by LimX Dynamics intended for R&D and real-world automation trials.
description: LimX Dynamics CL-1 is a full-size bipedal humanoid research platform built for developing and testing embodied AI and automation workflows. Provided specs indicate ~1.8 m height, ~70 kg weight, ~30 DOF, ~10 kg payload, and ~1.5 m/s walking speed. It supports ROS 2 on Ubuntu with an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin and uses vision sensors (mono/depth/stereo cameras and LiDAR).

name: Cart
summary: Cart is a wheeled service robot from Macco Robotics for autonomous food and beverage delivery in hospitality venues.
description: Cart is a service robot designed to assist in food and beverage delivery in commercial settings such as restaurants, cafes, and hotels. It autonomously navigates environments to streamline operations and enhance customer experience.

name: DBot
summary: DBot is a wheeled service robot from Macco Robotics for hospitality venues, combining autonomous operation with voice interaction.
description: DBot by Macco Robotics is a wheeled mobile service platform aimed at commercial hospitality and entertainment use. It supports semi-autonomous operation with voice control and onboard AI/computer vision. Key stated specs include ~1.7 m height, 65 kg weight, 10 kg payload, up to 1.2 m/s speed, and ~8 hours runtime with ~4 hours charging.

name: KIME
summary: KIME is a humanoid hospitality service robot from Macco Robotics that autonomously dispenses beverages and can serve some food items in commercial venues.
description: KIME is a 2 m-tall humanoid service robot with a head/torso and two articulating arms, designed for bars, restaurants, events, airports, and stadiums. It dispenses drinks (e.g., coffee, beer, cocktails) and can handle some food items. Reported features include pouring a beer in ~23 seconds, multi-language support (up to 10), and antimicrobial materials for hygiene; it can run standalone or as part of a kiosk.

name: MenteeBot
summary: MenteeBot is an AI-focused humanoid robotics platform from Mentee Robotics aimed at education, research, and commercial applications.
description: MenteeBot is a humanoid robot platform by Mentee Robotics positioned as an AI-first system for real-world automation workflows. Public materials indicate capabilities such as computer vision, SLAM, path planning, and object recognition, with ROS support and developer access via open APIs and languages including Python, C++, and JavaScript. Pricing and detailed hardware specs are not publicly disclosed.

name: MELFA RV-8CRL
summary: Mitsubishi Electric MELFA RV-8CRL is a 6-axis collaborative industrial robot arm with an 8 kg payload for factory automation tasks.
description: MELFA RV-8CRL is a stationary 6‑DOF collaborative robot arm (cobot) from Mitsubishi Electric Robotics with an 8 kg payload. It is designed for manufacturing automation such as assembly, pick-and-place, and machine tending where close human-robot proximity is required. Typical deployments integrate end-of-arm tooling and safety functions like emergency stop and collision detection.

name: MAiRA
summary: MAiRA is a 7‑axis collaborative robot arm from NEURA Robotics designed for industrial automation with integrated AI perception and voice interaction.
description: MAiRA (Multi-sensing Intelligent Robotic Assistant) is an advanced collaborative industrial robot equipped with AI-driven perception, designed for tasks requiring precision and safety. It is the world's first robot to combine multi-sensory capabilities with full autonomy.

name: NEURA 4NE1
summary: NEURA 4NE1 is a full-size humanoid robot platform from NEURA Robotics aimed at industrial and logistics tasks, with NVIDIA Thor compute and a reservation-based rollout.
description: NEURA 4NE1 (Gen 3.5) is a ~1.8 m, ~80 kg humanoid robot designed for human-robot collaboration in industrial environments. Listed capabilities include 25+ DOF, up to 100 kg max lift (with lower mobile payload), ~5 km/h top speed, 360° perception with sensor skin, and hot-swappable battery operation (about 6–8 hours). Interfaces include Wi‑Fi 6, Ethernet, ROS 2, and Python/C++ SDKs.

name: NEURA 4NE1 Mini
summary: NEURA 4NE1 Mini is a compact humanoid robot from NEURA Robotics aimed at education and research, offered in Standard and Pro configurations.
description: 4NE1 Mini is a 1.32 m tall, 36 kg humanoid designed for education, research, and interactive demos. It supports up to 3 kg payload and provides developer interfaces including a Python SDK and ROS 2 interface. Connectivity includes Wi‑Fi 6 and Ethernet. A Pro version adds dexterous hands (12 DoF) and additional developer features such as C++ SDK access and teleoperation tools.

name: NEURA MiPA
summary: NEURA MiPA is a planned personal home companion robot from NEURA Robotics for everyday assistance tasks.
description: NEURA MiPA is a consumer-oriented home companion robot announced by NEURA Robotics. It is positioned for daily routine support in home environments, with intended functions such as cleaning and organizing help plus personal assistance/monitoring. Detailed public specifications (dimensions, payload, sensors, runtime) and pricing have not been disclosed.

name: MZ07
summary: NACHI MZ07 is a compact 6-axis industrial articulated robot designed for high-speed handling and assembly tasks.
description: NACHI-FUJIKOSHI MZ07 is a fixed-base, 6‑DOF industrial articulated robot arm with a 7 kg payload. It is used for high-speed pick-and-place, small parts handling, and assembly in manufacturing automation cells. Typical deployments integrate it with industrial controllers, safety hardware, and end-of-arm tooling for repetitive production work.

name: LD-250 AMR
summary: Omron LD-250 is a wheeled autonomous mobile robot (AMR) for moving materials in factories and warehouses with up to 250 kg payload.
description: LD-250 is a wheeled industrial AMR designed for autonomous material transport in manufacturing and warehouse logistics. It carries up to 250 kg and reaches about 1.2 m/s on level indoor floors (up to ~3% incline). It uses safety laser scanning (front) plus rear sensing and supports fleet/deployment workflows via Omron’s MobilePlanner software.

name: OnX Service Humanoid
summary: OnX Service Humanoid (OnX-1) is a bipedal humanoid robot platform from OnX Robotics for service and enterprise automation pilots.
description: OnX Service Humanoid (model OnX-1) is a 1.7 m, 65 kg bipedal humanoid designed for service workflows such as hospitality and retail. It supports voice interaction and computer vision, includes multi-camera sensing with LiDAR, and runs Ubuntu with ROS 2 on an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin. Listed as pre-order with enterprise/quote-based purchasing.

name: ARI
summary: ARI is a human-size wheeled service robot from PAL Robotics for human–robot interaction in public spaces and labs.
description: ARI is a humanoid service robot designed for interaction and communication in environments such as retail, healthcare, and research. It features advanced AI for natural language processing and user interaction.

name: TALOS
summary: TALOS is a full-size biped humanoid robot platform from PAL Robotics for research and industrial prototyping using ROS and torque control.
description: TALOS is PAL Robotics’ torque-controllable, ROS-based high-performance biped humanoid robot designed to boost research. It is customizable (head/gripper), exposes rich sensing through ros_control, and uses an EtherCAT network for low-latency control loops.

name: TIAGo
summary: TIAGo by PAL Robotics is a wheeled mobile manipulator for research and education, combining a navigation base with a single arm and sensor suite.
description: TIAGo is a versatile mobile manipulator robot designed for research and development purposes. It combines mobility, perception, and manipulation to assist in various applications like human-robot interaction and industrial tasks.

name: Robot Pi
summary: Robot Pi (π) is an upper-body humanoid robot from Physical Robotics built for dexterous, force-controlled manipulation using multi-DOF hands.
description: Robot Pi (π) by Physical Robotics is a legless, upper-body humanoid designed for stable operation around people. It uses advanced force control (rather than position control) and multi-degree-of-freedom hands for delicate gripping and intricate object manipulation. Target applications include precision work and productivity support in manufacturing, healthcare, and logistics, plus real-world data collection for Physical Intelligence training.

name: Promobot V.4
summary: Promobot V.4 is an autonomous humanoid service robot for customer-facing tasks in public and commercial spaces.
description: Promobot V.4 is a wheeled humanoid service robot with a 10.1" touchscreen, face recognition cameras, microphone array, speakers, and ultrasonic/3D sensors for obstacle avoidance. It can answer questions, guide visitors, scan documents, manage e-queues, accept payments, and print items such as receipts or passes. Runs on Linux with proprietary software and supports autonomous docking for up to ~8 hours operation.

name: BellaBot
summary: BellaBot is a wheeled indoor delivery robot from Pudu Robotics built for tray-based item transport in venues like restaurants.
description: BellaBot is a wheeled autonomous indoor service robot designed for multi-tray delivery of items such as food and drinks in hospitality and retail environments. It uses onboard navigation sensors (including LiDAR) for obstacle avoidance and routing, and supports voice interaction. Approx. 129cm tall, ~60kg, with up to ~40kg payload and ~12–24h runtime depending on workload.

name: Robo-C 2
summary: Robo-C 2 is a human-shaped service robot by Qihan Technology designed for interactive front-desk and exhibition scenarios.
description: Robo-C 2 is a humanoid robot featuring hyper-realistic silicone skin that can be customized to match specific individual appearances. It supports 40+ languages, built-in ID scanning, and payment processing.

name: Sanbot
summary: Sanbot S1 is a wheeled, service-oriented humanoid robot from Qihan Technology for public-facing interaction.
description: Sanbot S1 is a compact wheeled service humanoid for customer-facing deployments such as reception, retail guidance, and demonstrations. It supports voice interaction and computer vision (including face recognition) and can operate semi-autonomously for patrol/engagement tasks. Reported specs include ~90 cm height, ~19 kg weight, 10 DoF, ~0.8 m/s speed, and ~8 h runtime.

name: Sanbot Elf
summary: Sanbot Elf is a compact wheeled service robot from Qihan Technology for reception, guidance, and interactive engagement.
description: Sanbot Elf (Qihan Technology) is an indoor, wheeled service/companion robot used for front-desk reception, customer engagement, and education demos. It supports voice interaction and vision-based functions such as face/object recognition, with onboard cameras including an RGB/depth sensor. Typical deployments include retail, hospitality, healthcare lobbies, and classrooms.

name: Sanbot King Kong
summary: Sanbot King Kong is a large wheeled humanoid service robot from Qihan Technology for reception, education, and event/venue interaction.
description: Sanbot King Kong is a human-shaped, wheeled indoor service robot used for customer engagement in venues such as education settings, exhibitions, and hospitality. It supports autonomous navigation, voice interaction, and vision-based features such as face recognition. Provided specs indicate ~1.4m height, ~50kg weight, ~10kg payload, and up to ~10 hours runtime (Li‑ion).

name: Sanbot Nano
summary: Sanbot Nano is a compact wheeled companion/service robot from Qihan, built for voice interaction and basic autonomous navigation.
description: Sanbot Nano is a ~90 cm tall, ~19 kg wheeled companion robot from Qihan Technology for home and light commercial use. It supports voice interaction, face recognition and computer-vision features via onboard cameras, plus Wi‑Fi/Bluetooth connectivity. Typical uses include companionship, reception/hospitality greetings and simple entertainment/education demos.

name: RB-Y1
summary: RB-Y1 is Rainbow Robotics’ dual-arm mobile manipulator platform for AI research and real-world automation use.
description: RB-Y1 is a dual-arm mobile manipulator from Rainbow Robotics aimed at AI research and deployment-oriented automation. It combines a dual-arm upper body with a mobile base and is supported by published resources such as an RB-Y1 web manual and GitHub materials. Intended applications include research, education, and commercial development.

name: Modular Robot with Paneled Body
summary: Realbotix M-Series is a modular robot with a paneled body and interchangeable face/body components for lifelike interaction use cases.
description: Realbotix M-Series is a modular robot platform with configurable body panels and an interchangeable face designed for service-sector roles that benefit from lifelike appearance and personality. Realbotix highlights 14+ facial motion points, micro-cameras embedded in the eyes for face/voice recognition, and an AI-agnostic approach intended to integrate with various AI platforms.

name: Robotic AI Enabled Bust
summary: Realbotix B‑Series is a stationary, AI-enabled robotic bust with expressive facial motion and modular customization.
description: The Realbotix B‑Series is a stationary robotic bust designed for conversational interaction and expressive facial animation. It uses 17 motors (17 DOF) to produce multiple facial expressions and supports integration with various AI platforms, including Realbotix’s proprietary AI and external models via API. Customers can choose pre-designed faces or commission custom designs; pricing starts at $20K (customization adds cost).

name: Sawyer
summary: Sawyer is a 7‑axis single-arm collaborative robot (cobot) from Rethink Robotics for flexible industrial automation.
description: Rethink Robotics’ Sawyer is a stationary 7‑DOF collaborative robot arm introduced in 2015. It targets manufacturing tasks such as machine tending, assembly and inspection, using integrated sensing (including vision and force/torque sensing) and the Intera software environment. Rated payload is about 4 kg; the original platform is discontinued and found mainly on the secondary market.

name: Dex
summary: Dex is a mobile humanoid service robot from Richtech Robotics for commercial customer-facing environments.
description: Dex is a wheeled, mobile humanoid-style service robot intended for commercial and entertainment venues. It supports semi-autonomous operation with voice interaction and computer vision, and is positioned for customer assistance and general service tasks in settings like hospitality and retail. Published specs list ~1.6 m height, ~45 kg mass, 20 DOF, ~5 kg payload, ~1.2 m/s max speed, and ~8 h runtime.

name: STAR1
summary: Robot Era STAR1 is a full-size bipedal humanoid robot designed for real-world work scenarios such as manufacturing, logistics, and service tasks.
description: STAR1 (Robot Era) is a full-size bipedal humanoid (about 1.8m, 85kg) intended for factory collaboration, warehousing/logistics handling, and commercial service. The company highlights autonomous navigation and obstacle avoidance plus manipulation for assembly, inspection, packaging, and material transport. It is marketed with deployment-ready software tooling and human-robot interaction capabilities.

name: OP3 Humanoid
summary: ROBOTIS OP3 is a small bipedal humanoid research and education platform with 20 DOF and an open software stack used in robotics competitions and labs.
description: OP3 is a ~46 cm, ~3.5 kg bipedal humanoid from ROBOTIS designed for education and robotics research, including RoboCup-style development. It uses 20 DYNAMIXEL actuators and supports ROS on Ubuntu via an onboard Intel NUC, with Wi‑Fi/Bluetooth/Ethernet connectivity and a USB camera for vision-based projects.

name: SR210A
summary: SIASUN SR210A is a 6-axis industrial robot model intended for factory automation tasks in manufacturing environments.
description: SR210A is a SIASUN 6‑DOF industrial robot for automated manufacturing workflows. Public listing data indicates a rated payload of 210 kg, suitable for heavy handling and related industrial processes. SIASUN positions its industrial robot portfolio for applications such as welding/cutting, assembly/testing, and logistics automation as part of broader smart manufacturing solutions.

name: Pepper
summary: Pepper is a 1.2 m humanoid social robot for greeting, guidance, and customer interaction in public venues.
description: Pepper is a humanoid, bipedal social robot designed for human interaction in commercial and public-facing settings. It uses speech interaction and computer vision to engage visitors, answer questions, provide recommendations, and guide people. Typical deployments include retail, hospitality, healthcare reception/wayfinding, and education demos. Pepper has 20 DOF, is ~120 cm tall, and weighs ~28 kg.

name: TX2-90
summary: Stäubli TX2-90 is a 6-axis fixed-base industrial robot arm for automated handling and process tasks.
description: TX2-90 is a fixed, 6-axis industrial articulated robot arm in Stäubli’s TX2 series. It is designed for factory automation tasks such as machine tending, pick-and-place, and general handling where repeatable motion and integration with industrial controllers are required. It is typically deployed as part of a larger automation cell with appropriate end-of-arm tooling and safety systems.

name: TM12
summary: Techman Robot TM12 is a 6-axis collaborative robotic arm with 12 kg payload designed for industrial automation tasks.
description: TM12 is a stationary 6‑DOF collaborative robot arm from Techman Robot with a rated 12 kg payload. It is positioned for flexible industrial automation such as material handling, assembly, inspection, machine tending, dispensing and packaging, using Techman’s integrated vision/AI tooling and TMflow programming workflow.

name: Tesla Bot
summary: Tesla Bot (Optimus) is a humanoid biped robot Tesla is developing to perform repetitive or unsafe tasks in human environments.
description: Tesla Bot (Optimus) is a general-purpose humanoid, bipedal robot under development by Tesla for automating repetitive or hazardous work. It is intended to operate in human spaces and manipulate objects with humanlike arms/hands, using Tesla’s AI/computer-vision expertise. Publicly confirmed specifications and commercial availability details remain limited.

name: T-HR3
summary: Toyota T-HR3 is a prototype humanoid robot built for whole-body teleoperation and HRI research.
description: T-HR3 is a humanoid robot developed by Toyota designed for advanced human-robot interaction. It showcases synchronized movement and remote operation capabilities to assist in various environments, including medical and disaster response.

name: Alpha 1E
summary: UBTECH Alpha 1E is listed on an official UBTECH Alpha Series page under consumer humanoid robots.
description: UBTECH maintains an official Alpha 1E page under the consumer humanoid robots section of its Alpha Series site. The currently published metadata is concise, so HumanoidHub records official identity, portfolio placement, and official images while leaving richer capabilities and commercial details for later manufacturer-source review.

name: Cruzr S2
summary: UBTECH Cruzr S2 is a full-sized wheeled humanoid robot positioned for industrial and enterprise deployment scenarios.
description: UBTECH presents Cruzr S2 on its official commercial product page as a full-sized industrial wheeled humanoid robot. The official description cites 15 kg payload handling, sub-millimeter precision, and enterprise deployment solutions, while pricing is not published as a fixed public amount.

name: Panda Robot
summary: UBTECH Panda Robot is an interactive humanoid panda robot for exhibition guidance, dance performance, and drawing activities.
description: UBTECH presents Panda Robot on its official humanoid product page as an interactive humanoid panda. The official description states that the product is specially designed for exhibition guidance, dance performance, and handwriting and drawing, which keeps this row scoped to humanoid-service use rather than the broader consumer hardware catalog.

name: Walker C
summary: UBTECH Walker C is a full-size electric-driven humanoid service robot for tour guidance and human-robot interaction.
description: UBTECH presents Walker C on its official product page as a humanoid service robot. The official description states that Walker C is a full-size, electric-driven embodied intelligent humanoid robot that offers intelligent tour guide services and human-robot interaction experiences for commercial applications.

name: Walker S
summary: UBTECH Walker S is an industrial humanoid robot for multi-task industrial scenarios, smart manufacturing, and enterprise automation.
description: UBTECH presents Walker S on its official product page as an industrial humanoid robot for multi-task industrial scenarios. The official description states that it is designed for smart manufacturing and enterprise automation and that it can observe the surrounding environment with built-in high-resolution RGBD visual sensors.

name: Walker S1
summary: UBTECH Walker S1 is a humanoid robot positioned for multi-task industrial scenarios and vehicle manufacturing assistance.
description: UBTECH presents Walker S1 on its official product page as a humanoid robot for multi-task industrial scenarios. The official description cites intelligent mobility, AI perception, industrial-grade applications, vehicle manufacturing assembly-line assistance, and collaborative work with autonomous logistics vehicles.

name: Walker S2
summary: UBTECH Walker S2 is a new-generation industrial humanoid robot with autonomous battery swapping for 24/7 operation in manufacturing and material-handling workflows.
description: UBTECH positions Walker S2 as an industrial humanoid robot for production-line work and mass production delivery. Its official page highlights autonomous hot-swappable batteries, a dual-battery power architecture, 15 kg payload handling, 2 m/s walking speed, binocular stereo vision, Gen-4 dexterous hands, and UBTECH Co-Agent/BrainNet 2.0 task coordination for industrial scenarios.

name: Walker X
summary: UBTECH Walker X is a commercial humanoid robot positioned for AI research, smart services, and human-robot interaction.
description: UBTECH presents Walker X on its official product page as a commercial humanoid robot. The official page description positions it as a next-generation humanoid robot for AI research, smart services, and human-robot interaction, and cites advanced mobility, intelligent perception, and real-world applications.

name: Unitree A2
summary: Unitree A2 is a heavy-payload quadruped robot designed for industrial inspection and logistics tasks.
description: Unitree A2 is an industrial quadruped (12 DoF) built for fast mobile operation and carrying loads. It is listed at 42 kg with up to 5 m/s speed, ~5 hours runtime (907 Wh battery), 45° slope capability, and 30 cm step height. Stated payloads include 100 kg standing load and 25 kg walking load, with IP56 ingress protection noted.

name: Unitree As2
summary: Unitree As2 is a compact industrial quadruped robot designed for mobile inspection and research tasks. It is rated IP54, has 12 DOF, and a specified top speed up to 5 m/s.
description: Unitree As2 is a compact four-legged (quadruped) mobile robot for industrial mobility and R&D/education use. Provided specs indicate 12 degrees of freedom, IP54 ingress protection, ~18 kg body weight, ~457 mm height, and up to 5 m/s speed. Listed load figures include ~15 kg while walking and up to ~65 kg standing load. Offered in AIR, PRO, and EDU configurations.

name: Unitree R1 EDU
summary: Unitree R1 EDU is an education-oriented humanoid R1 configuration intended for teaching and robotics research.
description: Unitree R1 EDU is an education-focused version of Unitree’s R1 humanoid platform. It is aimed at robotics courses and lab research, and is offered in configurations around 26 DOF with an advertised maximum of 40 DOF. Public listing details also cite an NVIDIA Jetson Orin compute option and optional dexterous hand hardware, depending on configuration.

name: UR20 Cobot
summary: Universal Robots UR20 is a 6-axis collaborative robotic arm with 1750 mm reach and up to 25 kg payload.
description: UR20 is a stationary 6‑DOF collaborative robot arm from Universal Robots. It offers up to 25 kg payload, 1750 mm reach, and a Ø245 mm footprint, with published repeatability down to ±0.03 mm for UR cobots. Intended for industrial tasks such as palletizing, machine tending, welding, assembly, and material handling, and supported by the UR+ ecosystem for end-effectors and software.

name: VinRobotics District 1
summary: District 1 is a VinRobotics humanoid robot platform aimed at industrial and service labor applications.
description: VinRobotics District 1 is a bipedal humanoid robot platform developed by VinRobotics as part of its industrial humanoid robotics efforts. The company positions its humanoids for industrial and service applications and highlights in-house development of mechanical structures and intelligent control systems. Detailed public specs (payload, speed, battery, sensors) are not provided in the cited sources.

name: Iron Humanoid
summary: Iron Humanoid is a bipedal humanoid robot platform attributed to XPENG Robotics; public product details and sales info are not available from the provided official URL.
description: Iron Humanoid (model: Iron) is described as a humanoid/bipedal robotics platform intended for general-purpose automation, research, and demonstrations. The only provided official link (xpengrobotics.com) appears to be a domain-for-sale page, so specifications, availability, pricing, and certifications cannot be verified from the manufacturer site.

name: CyberOne
summary: CyberOne is Xiaomi’s full-size biped humanoid robot prototype unveiled in 2022 for R&D and technology demonstrations.
description: CyberOne is Xiaomi Robotics’ biped humanoid prototype (2022) intended for research, developer experimentation, and demos of perception and interaction. Publicly stated details include 1.77 m height, ~52 kg weight, 21 DOF, and a listed walking speed around 3.6 km/h (~1.0 m/s). It is not broadly sold as a standardized commercial product.

name: MOTOMAN HC10DTP
summary: MOTOMAN HC10DTP is a 6-axis collaborative industrial robot arm from Yaskawa with a 10 kg payload for close-proximity operation with people.
description: The MOTOMAN HC10DTP is a highly versatile industrial collaborative robot designed for tasks such as assembly, material handling, and machine tending. Its advanced safety features allow for human-robot collaboration without the need for additional safety fencing.
